items.text: This is also a decision about your high-value skill portfolio, not just your next job title.
You like infrastructure, scripting, and troubleshooting more than writing application code from scratch.
"Cloud computing career" is not one job, it is at least four different roles with different daily work, different entry bars, and different ceilings.
Sets up and maintains the actual infrastructure, virtual machines, storage, networking, identity access, so applications have somewhere reliable to run.

blocks.heading: Getting in From a Non-Cloud IT Background

items.text: Most people asking about cloud computing career skills in India are not starting from zero, they are already in some IT-adjacent role and want a realistic bridge, not a full career reset.
The most direct bridge available in India.
You already manage Windows Server, Linux boxes, or basic networking in your current role.

blocks.heading: Matters More Than Most Self-Taught Roadmaps Admit

items.text: Before touching a cloud console, get comfortable with basic Linux commands, how DNS and IP addressing work, and what a firewall or security group actually controls.

Choose AWS, Azure, or GCP based on the job postings you actually see in your target city or the industry you want to enter, then commit to that one platform for your first few months instead of splitting attention across all three.
Do not buy another certification course before you have picked your target platform and set up a free tier account for a real project.
Pick one career path from the four above based on the daily work, not the job title.
Then pick one platform based on job postings in your target city, and start a real lab project before scheduling any exam.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: AWS vs Azure vs GCP: the honest comparison

rows: AWS
Largest global market share and the broadest set of services (200+), which usually translates to the widest range of job postings in India, especially in Bengaluru.
Widest ecosystem, most third-party training material, most community support for troubleshooting.
Microsoft Azure

Second-largest by market share and, in a large share of Indian enterprise job postings, the platform with the most listings overall, driven by companies already running Microsoft 365 and on-premise Windows infrastructure.
Strong fit if the target employer is a large traditional enterprise, bank, or government-adjacent organisation already invested in Microsoft tools.
Google Cloud (GCP)

Smallest of the three in India by job volume, but the fastest-growing by percentage, concentrated in data-heavy and AI-heavy companies using BigQuery, Kubernetes (GKE), and Google's AI infrastructure.
Strong choice if the target direction is data engineering, analytics, or Kubernetes specifically, GCP is considered the strongest platform for Kubernetes work.
AWS
Breadth can be a downside for a beginner, the sheer number of services makes it easy to spread learning too thin.
Microsoft Azure
Fewer public community resources than AWS for troubleshooting edge cases, though Microsoft Learn documentation is strong.
Google Cloud (GCP)
Fewer total openings means less flexibility if you need to change employers quickly in a smaller city.
